_readme: Role packs: curated skill sets per job. Each pack must fit the 8,000-char discovery budget (checked in CI). Install with: python scripts/install_skills.py --pack <name> --target <dir>, or npx skills add alphasafal/production-agent-skills --skill <each skill>.

backend-engineer.title: Backend / full-stack engineer
backend-engineer.description: Understand a codebase, ship features safely, debug what breaks, review what merges.

tech-lead.title: Tech lead / architect
tech-lead.description: Review designs before they're built, make decisions you can defend, hold the review bar.

sre.title: SRE / DevOps
sre.description: Run incidents, keep the deploy pipeline safe, find root causes after the fire is out.

security.title: Security engineer
security.description: Threat-model designs before they're built, audit code before it launches, review risky diffs.

data-scientist.title: Data scientist / analyst
data-scientist.description: Rigorous analysis and modeling with leakage checks and baselines; decisions backed by evidence.

product-manager.title: Product manager
product-manager.description: Turn vague ideas into right-sized MVPs and PRDs, decide with evidence, read the data.
